last_them: Hi, thanks for making the time today. This session is about an hour of system design.

live.text: Given a stream of integers, return the median after each one arrives.
live.focus: two heaps, balancing, O(log n) insert
approach: Keep a max-heap of the lower half and a min-heap of the upper half.
Insert into one heap, then move its top across so the sizes differ by ≤ 1.
The median is the larger heap's top, or the mean of both tops.
Each insert is O(log n); reading the median is O(1).
